column5: The application singleton passes this predicate to dispatch_once and the observer block fills the next word. The startup and metadata cache predicates and retained metadata follow them.
The iTunesMetadata block calls this plist reader with its iTunesMetadataPath value and an NSError output. The pinned GADApplication object exports this function.
The launch-notification block installed by +load sets the launch flag and starts early activities.
The singleton's dispatch_once block allocates the captured class and stores the initialized application.
The singleton block descriptor's copy field points to this helper.
The singleton block descriptor's dispose field points to this helper.
The early-activities block invokes the interceptor and registers network adapters.
The iTunes metadata cache block calls the plist reader with the captured application's metadata path.
The metadata block descriptor's copy field points to this helper.
The metadata block descriptor's dispose field points to this helper.
